item.text: The point is physical for the eta configuration: the \(p\eta\) threshold is about 1.486 GeV, so \(W=1.520\) GeV is roughly 34 MeV above it. I’m using the repository’s standard CLAS12 settings (6.53 GeV beam and \(v_{\rm cut}=0.166\ \mathrm{GeV}^2\)).
